structured.answer: According to the page, I'd hold the money at פסגות (marked "הזול") and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", with 0% management fee. It says I'd end up with 86,492 ₪ after 10 years on 70,000 ₪ put in. But that seems too little for 7% a year, and פסגות isn't my bank (לאומי is second at 83,396 ₪), so I'll go over it with my son before doing anything.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the buttons with MSCI / S&P 500
stuck.why: It opens with English letters and מדד; it felt like it wasn't for me, and I only went on because I came for S&P 500
7% for 10 years should be about 70% more; I don't understand why it's so much less, maybe 'ריאליים'
A minus sign; I wasn't sure whether it's a loss
Colours too close together; couldn't match them to the words

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד'
Boxes סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500, תשואה בשנה 7%
Bank list: פסגות first, לאומי 83,396 second
Fund box 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)', דמי ניהול 0%
skimmed: Bank list below the first few (הפועלים, דיסקונט, מרכנתיל, אלטשולר...)
'לא בחישוב' notes about prices for soldiers/students
Small text at the top of the list about how the price is calculated
skipped: The coloured bar and its legend
The fold arrows next to each bank
'כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500' list and everything after screen 7
not_found: A plain sentence explaining why the result is far below 7% × 10 years
Whether my own bank's deposit would be safer or compare
A clear statement of how much risk there is of losing money

findings.what: Final amount (86,492 on 70,000 at 7%) looks wrong to a simple reader; 'ריאליים' is not explained in plain words
Opens with English index names (MSCI, S&P 500), which pushes off an older reader looking for safe saving
Dark background with grey and small text is hard to read
findings.where: All screens, especially the small explanatory lines at the top of screen 4 and 'הפס נחתך' on screen 7

findings.what: Colour bar uses close colours that can't be told apart
findings.where: Screens 3 and 7, cost bar and legend

findings.what: Minus sign and red bars feel alarming without explanation
Too many numbers per row (two amounts plus a bar plus notes)
Jargon with no explanation: דמי משמרת, נאמן, קרן מחקה, נטרול מט"ח
English fund names and Interactive Brokers mixed into a Hebrew list
